behavioralGates.requirement: The observer and every dashboard read model use the same tenant trading identity: funder_address when present, otherwise the legacy signer address.
behavioralGates.evidence: Current production observed the Privy signer EOA while balance and position reads used the funder wallet; the active fix enrolls funder_address and retires the stale signer row.

behavioralGates.requirement: Open-position count, market value, and execution live count for the trading wallet match an independent Polygon/Data-API oracle and never silently collapse to zero.
behavioralGates.evidence: Production screenshot reports no open positions while independent evidence reports approximately $45.49 across live positions.

behavioralGates.requirement: Total wallet value is cash plus marked positions; if positions are unavailable, Total is unknown or explicitly labeled partial and is never a cash-only value presented as total.
behavioralGates.evidence: Production displayed Total $0.53 while position data was absent and real positions were approximately $45.49.

behavioralGates.requirement: P/L history resolves the actual trading wallet and distinguishes missing observation data from a true zero history.
behavioralGates.evidence: The same signer-versus-funder key mismatch affects wallet lookup for P/L history.

behavioralGates.requirement: Authenticated POST /api/v1/work/items returns 201 and creates a hub work item in Doltgres.
behavioralGates.evidence: Production currently returns HTTP 405 because the collection route exports GET only.

behavioralGates.requirement: Authenticated PATCH and DELETE use the Dolt-backed command adapter, and mutations remain present after a pod restart.
behavioralGates.evidence: The item route exports GET only and the current container wires MarkdownWorkItemAdapter for commands.

behavioralGates.requirement: The deployed hub reads and writes work items through Doltgres; repository Markdown is an explicitly temporary manager fallback, not runtime persistence.
behavioralGates.evidence: Merge d685fc8 (node-template upstream #32) replaced the legacy Dolt CRUD seams with a GET-only Markdown-backed path.
